description: Resolve up to 40 hostnames now through Cloudflare DNS over HTTPS (A, AAAA and the CNAME chain). Each host is marked live, nxdomain, no_records or dangling_cname (a CNAME whose target does not exist, a subdomain takeover lead), and CNAME targets on cloud platforms (S3, Azure, Heroku, GitHub Pages, Netlify, Vercel and others) are named. Also probes a random label per parent domain to detect wildcard DNS. DNS lookups only; no connection is made to the hosts.

check_wildcard.description: Probe one random label under each parent domain (max 3) to detect wildcard DNS.

name: resolve_subdomains
title: Resolve subdomains (DNS over HTTPS)
